description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - code hold: a friend reads you a WiFi password, a temporary door code or a meeting number once and it is gone from your head. You repeat it back in your own voice (host speech recognition, after a wearer-mode mic availability check), check it character by character on the confirm screen - nothing is stored before you confirm - and correct it by re-dictating or by a per-digit stepper. Up to 4 codes are held as PLAIN TEXT in the app's local storage on the glasses (no encryption is claimed; that is why the burn flow exists). When you type the code on another device it is shown in your view in chunks of 4, silent by default; spoken chunk by chunk only when you ask. After typing, a two-step burn deletes it for good
name: code-hold
